statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The concern is for intermittent arrhythmia as the underlying etiology of the collapse events
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved
